body:
Thanks for the great thread. We are on Next 13 and React 18 and have 6.38.3 of instasearch hooks. We still have the back button issue mentioned above. 

Two quick questions: 

1. Is this fixed in the instantsearch-router-next-experimental package? 

2. Also, my quick fix is to just use standard 'a href' on the Search page, instead of Next Link component to link to the content. This reloads the page and everything works fine. What is wrong with this approach? I mean I understand you lose some benefits by not having the Link component in search, but at least everything works and it's just the search page. We can use Link elsewhere on the site.  I really haven't seen any difference in speed or usability using classic "a href" to link to content from the search. So I'm curious if this is a reasonable solution if we don't care about Link component on search?
